key_insight: Quantum Broker allocates a circuit’s measurement shots across heterogeneous QPUs to meet user-defined quality-of-service constraints and objectives.
engineering_relevance: Its provider-agnostic execution layer helps engineers manage cost, latency, fidelity, and reproducibility across fragmented quantum cloud platforms.
method: Exploit shot independence to distribute one circuit across multiple QPUs.
Express QoS requirements declaratively with QQSpec and profile available backends.
Optimize shot allocations using MILP or nonlinear dual-annealing solvers.
evidence_signal: Benchmark-circuit experiments on noisy simulator backends produced feasible QoS-aware plans and improved QoS satisfaction over single-backend and naive multi-backend baselines.
watch_item: The nonlinear solver improves allocation quality at higher planning cost; evaluation on noisy simulators does not establish performance on live QPUs.
paper_title: Quantum Broker: QoS-Aware Distribution of Quantum Computations
